title: Leahnito's Modpack
description: "Private" Instance to play on my smp server with my friends, some friends can't properly install mods or stuff like that so, that's why im making this project, for them...
body:
This modpack adds stuff like:
- Voicechat Mod
- Optimization Mods
- Client side stuff, to make some stuff "easy" or fancy
 
The purpouse of this, it's staying the most vanilla possible, so i will be adding new or removing some stuff depending of that..
